All In Status Report - Part 1: Root Directory

AeroVista�s Facebook (Meta) Page.txt

AeroVista’s Facebook (Meta) Page look crisp, credible, and super easy to grok. I’ll give you a tight setup checklist, image specs, and ready-to-paste copy that explains the whole multi-division thing without overwhelming folks.

Quick setup (do this first)

Create/convert the Page → Pages ▸ Create new Page ▸ add name + category, then bio. (Meta’s official steps.) 
Facebook
+1

Add your action button (“Learn more”, “Contact us”, “Shop”, “Sign up”). You can swap later as needed. 
Facebook
+1

Turn on the Services tab (if it’s not visible, add it in Templates & Tabs). We’ll use it as your “menu” of offerings. 
Rice Content

Complete business info (username, hours, email, phone, location/time zone). 
Facebook

Image specs (current best-practice)

Profile photo (logo): Upload ≥ 320×320 px (square); Facebook crops it circularly. Displays around 196×196 on phones and ~176×176 on desktop. Keep important bits centered. 
Buffer
+2
Facebook
+2

Cover photo: Displays 820×312 (desktop) and 640×360 (mobile). Safe upload choices: 820×360 (matches mobile height) or 851×315 (classic). Keep text/logos in the central “safe” strip so nothing is hidden behind the profile circle. 
Snappa
+2
Sprout Social
+2

Post images: 1200×630 (landscape) or 1080×1080 (square) work great. 
Madgicx
+1

Design notes for AeroVista

Profile: Use the AV “A” mark on flat background; no gradients; generous padding so the circle crop doesn’t clip.

Cover: Use your “7 divisions in orbit” concept (no gradients) over dark slate. Center headline + subline in the middle safe zone; keep logos toward the right side to avoid the profile overlap on mobile. (We can export both 820×360 and 851×315.)

Page identity

Page name: AeroVista LLC
Username: @AeroVistaOfficial (or @AeroVistaUS if @AeroVista is taken)

Primary category: “Business Service” or “Software Company” (secondary categories: “Marketing Agency”, “Media/Production”, “Education”, “Photography & Videography”)—pick what aligns best with current outreach. (You can have multiple.) 
Truehost

Bio (short, 101 characters max)

Where Vision Takes Flight. Multi-division studio for tech, creative, audio, and automation.

(Meta recommends a brief 1–2 sentence description—this fits the slot cleanly.) 
Facebook

About (long, paste into “Additional information” / “Details”)

AeroVista is a multi-division studio built to ship bold ideas—fast. We design and run modern systems across software & AI, brand & media, music & interactive, and aerial imaging. From concept to launch, our teams deliver the stack: strategy, build, automation, content, and support.

Divisions at a glance
• Nexus TechWorks — Full-stack apps, AI integrations, DevOps, security.
• SkyForge Creative Studios — Games, XR, interactive stories, 3D.
• EchoVerse Audio — Original music, sound design, scoring.
• Summit Learning — Training, documentation, onboarding.
• Lumina Creative — Branding, video, campaigns, social.
• Vespera Publishing — Digital publishing, courses, IP.
• Horizon Aerial & Visual — Drone cinema, mapping, 3D models.

How we work
Small, senior teams. Opinionated tooling. Transparent roadmaps. We build once, scale everywhere—securely.

Tagline: Where Vision Takes Flight.

Services menu (use the Page “Services” tab)

Add these as individual services with a photo, price range (or “Contact for quote”), and a 1–2 sentence summary each. 
Rice Content

AI & App Launch (Nexus TechWorks)
From discovery to deploy: modern web apps, AI copilots, data pipelines, and cloud infra with observability and security baked in.

Automation & n8n Workflows
Design, build, and monitor automations for ops, content, and customer engagement. Self-hosted or managed.

Brand, Web & Campaign Kit (Lumina Creative)
Identity, messaging, high-performing landing pages, and content systems that convert across web and social.

Music & Sound Design (EchoVerse Audio)
Custom cues, themes, SFX, and immersive audio for brands, games, and film.

Training & Playbooks (Summit Learning)
Role-ready curricula, SOPs, and interactive docs for rapid team enablement.

Aerial Imaging & 3D (Horizon Aerial & Visual)
Cinematic drone capture, real-estate reels, photogrammetry, and survey mapping.

Interactive / Games (SkyForge)
Playable prototypes to full experiences—Web, mobile, and XR.

(We can add more later; start with 6–8 to avoid choice overload.)

Call-to-action button (pick one to start)

Learn More → your main hub (AeroVista.us or /start page)

Contact Us → Messenger (and/or WhatsApp if you enable it)

Shop on Website → if you want to highlight merch/e-comm later
You can change the CTA based on campaigns. 
Facebook
+1

Feature blocks you can enable

Pinned Intro Post (do this right away)
Title: “Start here: What AeroVista does in 60 seconds”
Copy: “We’re a multi-division studio. Pick your need and we’ll route the right team.”
Buttons in post: links to your 7 division pages/anchors.

Story Highlights: “Work,” “Music,” “Automation,” “Drone,” “Docs” — 5 simple buckets.

Templates & Tabs: Turn on Services, About, Reviews, Photos, Videos. Hide tabs you won’t update monthly.

Messaging: Enable the FAQ auto-replies (e.g., “What do you do?”, “How to start?”, “Pricing?”, “Timeline?”) to speed responses.

Voice & content guidelines (for posts)

Carousel case studies (before → after → metrics)

Behind-the-build clips (30–60s devlogs, design timelapses)

Audio snippets (EchoVerse hooks)

Automation wins (“Saved 6 hours/week with this n8n flow”)

Drone reels (15–30s hero shots)
Format recap: square 1080×1080 or 1200×630 landscape both render cleanly. 
Madgicx
+1

Ready-to-paste content pack

Intro (pinned) post

Where Vision Takes Flight. We’re AeroVista—seven specialist divisions working as one studio. Need an app, automation, brand system, score, or aerial? Start here and we’ll route you to the right team.
🔗 Learn more → [your hub link]

FAQ quick replies (Messaging)

What do you do? → “We build apps, automation, brand systems, music/sound, and aerial visuals. Tell us your goal; we’ll scope a fast path.”

How do we start? → “Book a 15-min fit call. If we’re a match, we’ll estimate and draft a simple project order.”

Pricing? → “Fixed-fee options for defined scopes; retainers for ongoing growth. We’ll propose both.”

Services (short blurbs) — use the items from the Services menu above (each 140–180 chars).

About (short version, for the ‘Intro’ field)
A multi-division studio for tech, creative, audio, and aerial. Small senior teams; shipping > talking. Where Vision Takes Flight. 
Facebook

Cover & profile design brief (so we can export assets)

Profile

Asset: AV “A” monogram, flat background (charcoal #0B0F14), inner padding 14–18%. Export PNG, 1024×1024.

Cover (two exports)

Layout: Dark slate background, subtle grid. Center headline: “AeroVista” and subline “Where Vision Takes Flight.”

Visual: 7 division icons orbiting a central AV mark (no gradients), thin orbital paths, slight depth.

Exports: 820×360 and 851×315; keep all text within middle 60% safe zone per mobile/desktop variance.

✅ Bio (short) + About (long) filled

✅ Profile & Cover uploaded (mobile check)

✅ CTA button added

✅ Services tab populated (6–8 entries)

✅ Pinned intro post published

✅ Messaging FAQs enabled

✅ Tabs cleaned (only what you’ll maintain)

✅ Invite initial followers / link from your site & email footer

# 🧠 NXCore Dashboard — EOD Summary  
**Date:** 2025-11-04  
**System:** `nxcore`  
**User:** glyph  
**Focus:** Flask dashboard service, kiosk auto-launch, and display/session cleanup.

---

## ✅ **Completed Today**

### **1. Flask App Restored and Verified**
- Replaced corrupted `nxcore_dash.py` with a known-good working Flask version.  
- Verified `/health.json` responding correctly with live system metrics.  
- Systemd service now stable and auto-starting on port 8080.

### **2. LightDM Display Manager Working**
- `lightdm.service` successfully active (`:1`, seat0, tty7).  
- Confirmed auto-login user `dashboard` and single active display session.  

### **3. Openbox Autostart + Chromium Launch**
- Created and verified per-user autostart file at `/home/dashboard/.config/openbox/autostart`.
- Configured Chromium to run in kiosk mode pointing to `http://localhost:8080`.

### **4. Verified GUI Process Stack**
- Confirmed running processes for Xorg, Openbox, and Chromium tied to `dashboard` user.  
- Flask endpoint `/` returning dashboard HTML correctly.

---

## ⚙️ **Current State**
| Component | Status | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|
| `nxcore-dash.service` | ✅ Running | Flask responding on port 8080 |
| `/health.json` | ✅ Working | Returns correct JSON |
| `lightdm` | ✅ Active | GUI display running |
| `openbox` | ✅ Running | Linked to dashboard user |
| `chromium kiosk` | ⚠️ Partially working | Screen refresh noted but remains black — likely GPU/display mismatch |

---

## 🧩 **Pending / Next Steps**
1. Verify active DISPLAY and manually launch Chromium with `--disable-gpu` flags.  
2. Move inline HTML to `/srv/nxcore-dash/templates/index.html` for maintainability.  
3. Ensure autostart triggers properly via `.xsession-errors` log check.  
4. Confirm single LightDM seat and remove stale sessions.

---

## 🧾 **Summary Snapshot**
✅ Flask online  
✅ LightDM + Openbox active  
✅ Chromium installed and launchable  
⚠️ GUI black screen pending GPU/display parameter verification  

**Tomorrow’s focus:**  
- Validate Chromium GUI visibility (DISPLAY=:1)  
- Test GPU-off fallback mode  
- Confirm autostart persistence and kiosk reload after reboot

# EOD Status Report

**Project:** Moth Emporium "Bizn'Box"
**Date:** 2025-11-06

---

### Project Pages

-   **Page 1: `welcome.html`**: The starting point of the journey, introducing the user to the experience.
-   **Page 2: `brand_directions.html`**: The first major choice, where the user defines the overall direction of their brand.
-   **Page 3: `plan_overview.html`**: The hub for the detailed planning phase, presenting the different categories of choices.
-   **Page 4: `plan_products.html`**: The first step in detailed planning, where the user decides what to sell.
-   **Page 5: `plan_features.html`**: The next step, where the user chooses the features for their online store.
-   **Page 6: `plan_marketing.html`**: The final planning step, where the user decides how to market their store.
-   **Page 7: `export.html`**: The end of the planning phase, where the user can review and export their final plan.
-   **Page 8: `ai-assistant.html`**: A reusable AI assistant widget, available on all pages.

### ✅ Completed Tasks

-   **Project Scaffolding**: Created the complete page structure for the "Bizn'Box" planning journey (see "Project Pages" section).
-   **Brand Consolidation**: Proposed a unified brand identity around "Moth Emporium".
-   **Interactive Planning Flow**: Implemented a "choose your own adventure" style planning process with local storage and JSON export.
-   **Reusable Asset System**: Developed a system for a consistent header, footer, and AI assistant across all pages.
-   **Bug Fixes**: Resolved issues with links and local file fetching.

### ⏳ In-Progress Tasks

-   Awaiting user feedback on the current implementation.

### 🚀 Next Steps

-   Gather requirements for the "Ad" and "Monitoring" components.
-   Continue to iterate on the "Bizn'Box" experience.

### ❗ Blockers / Issues

-   None at this time.

# 📊 End of Day Report — AeroVista Presentation Assistant
**Date:** 2025-01-27  
**Project:** Presentation Assistant for Gray to Green Nursery Meeting  
**Status:** ✅ **COMPLETED**

---

## 📋 Executive Summary

Successfully created and enhanced a Presentation Assistant system for AeroVista LLC to support Bob and his wife during client meetings. The system includes two HTML files with full-featured assistant capabilities, persona-driven UI, voice input/output, document indexing, and intelligent Q&A powered by Python (Pyodide).

---

## ✅ Completed Tasks

### 1. **Enhanced `soc hub.html`** (Existing File)
**Status:** ✅ COMPLETED  
**Lines Modified:** ~470 lines added

#### Features Added:
- **Fixed-position Presentation Assistant Panel** (right-bottom corner)
  - Toggle-able UI with keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+P)
  - Presenter timer with start/stop/reset (Space/R keys)
  - Real-time timer display (MM:SS format)

- **Nova Persona Integration**
  - Colorful gradient avatar (conic-gradient with pink/cyan/yellow)
  - Personality description: energetic, witty, playful, ethical
  - Tech profile display

- **Document Loading System**
  - Auto-loads markdown files from `Assets/`, `Guides/`, root
  - Parses CSV files from `Databases/` (7 files)
  - Graceful error handling for missing files
  - Loads: `client_meeting_prep_kit_aero_vista_ready_to_print_package.md`, `nnotes.txt`, `Guides/README.md`, etc.

- **Pyodide Python Integration**
  - In-browser Python runtime (v0.26.2)
  - Custom summarization function with priority-based sentence scoring
  - Extracts key information from loaded documents
  - Prioritizes pricing, value propositions, outcomes, deliverables

- **Quick Action Buttons**
  - **Pricing** — Extracts Services Menu table from prep kit
  - **Services** — Same as Pricing (shows service offerings)
  - **Value props** — Extracts One-Page Capabilities section
  - **Scan all** — Summarizes all loaded documents
  - **Generate Pitch: Gray to Green** — Creates tailored pitch from docs

- **Interactive Q&A**
  - Textarea for custom questions
  - Answer button with Ctrl+Enter shortcut
  - Real-time document summarization

- **Demo Links**
  - Quick buttons to open demo sites:
    - `https://aerovista-sample.web.app/` (AeroVista Sample)
    - `https://aerovista-us.github.io/bonsaid/` (BONSAID Mini Store)

- **Keyboard Shortcuts**
  - `Ctrl+Enter` — Answer question
  - `Ctrl+Shift+P` — Toggle assistant panel
  - `Space` — Start/stop timer
  - `R` — Reset timer

---

**Status:** ✅ COMPLETED  
**File Size:** 173 lines  
**Type:** Full-page standalone presentation assistant

#### Features:

   - **After:** ~565 lines (with embedded assistant panel)

## 🔧 Technical Implementation Details

### Technologies Used:
- **HTML5** — Semantic markup
- **CSS3** — Flexbox, Grid, gradients, animations
- **JavaScript (ES6+)** — Async/await, Promises, event handling
- **Pyodide v0.26.2** — In-browser Python runtime (CDN)
- **Web Speech API** — Speech recognition & synthesis
- **Fetch API** — Document loading

### Data Sources Loaded:
**Markdown Files:**
- `Assets/Icons-and-Emoji.md`
- `client_meeting_prep_kit_aero_vista_ready_to_print_package.md`
- `nnotes.txt`
- `Guides/README.md`
- `Guides/Import-Instructions.md`
- `Guides/Workspace-Structure.md`

**CSV Files:**
- `Databases/Tasks.csv`
- `Databases/Projects.csv`
- `Databases/CRM.csv`
- `Databases/OKRs.csv`
- `Databases/Content-Calendar.csv`
- `Databases/Asset-Library.csv`
- `Databases/Risks.csv`

### Key Functions:
1. **`parseCSV(text)`** — Basic CSV parser (handles headers, rows)
2. **`loadText(path)`** — Async file loader with error handling
3. **`loadDocs()`** — Batch loads all markdown and CSV files
4. **`extractServices()`** — Extracts Services Menu table from prep kit
5. **`extractValue()`** — Extracts One-Page Capabilities section
6. **`ensurePy()`** — Initializes Pyodide and loads summarization function
7. **`summarizeJoin(chunks)`** — Python-based document summarization
8. **`boot()`** — Initializes document loading on page load

---

## 🎯 Use Cases Supported

1. **Quick Pricing Lookup**
   - One-click access to Services Menu with rates
   - Shows: Discovery ($3,500), MVP Build ($7,000), AI Integration ($3,000), etc.

2. **Value Proposition Extraction**
   - One-click access to AeroVista capabilities summary
   - Highlights divisions, core strengths, proof points

3. **Custom Q&A**
   - Type or speak questions about pricing, services, NDAs, etc.
   - AI-powered summarization extracts relevant answers

4. **Gray to Green Pitch Generation**
   - One-click button generates tailored pitch
   - References demo sites and service offerings
   - Includes Firebase Hosting, GA4, SSL, workflow info

5. **Document Scanning**
   - Scans all loaded documents and provides summary
   - Useful for quick overview of entire knowledge base

6. **Voice Interaction**
   - Speak questions instead of typing (Listen button)
   - Hear answers read aloud (Speak button)

7. **Demo Site Access**
   - Quick links to two live demo sites
   - Opens in new tabs for easy comparison

8. **Image Gallery**
   - Displays slideshow graphics for visual reference
   - Two-image grid layout

## 🚀 In Progress / Future Enhancements

### Potential Improvements:
1. **Playwright Integration** — Could add automated screenshot capture of demo sites
2. **Enhanced Image Gallery** — Lightbox/modal view for full-size images
3. **Document Search** — Full-text search across all loaded documents
4. **Session History** — Save Q&A history for later reference

6. **Multi-language Support** — Extend speech recognition to other languages
7. **Offline Mode** — Service worker for offline document access
8. **Real-time Collaboration** — Share assistant state between devices

---

## 🐛 Known Issues / Limitations

1. **Browser Compatibility**
   - Speech Recognition requires Chrome/Edge (not Safari)
   - Speech Synthesis works in all modern browsers
   - Pyodide requires modern browser with WebAssembly support

2. **File Loading**
   - Files must be served via HTTP/HTTPS (not `file://` protocol)
   - CORS may block local file access in some browsers
   - **Solution:** Use local server (VS Code Live Server, Python http.server, etc.)

3. **Image Paths**
   - Image gallery uses URL-encoded filenames (spaces → `%20`)
   - If images don't load, check file names match exactly

4. **CSV Parsing**
   - Basic CSV parser doesn't handle quoted fields or commas within cells
   - Works for simple CSV files (like the Databases folder)

5. **Pyodide Loading**
   - First load may take 5-10 seconds (downloads ~5MB runtime)
   - Subsequent loads are cached

\fs24\lang1033\langfe1033\kerning2\loch\af31506\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\cgrid\langnp1033\langfenp1033 {\rtlch\fcs1 \af31507 \ltrch\fcs0 \insrsid6037862 \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 # NXCore Critical Fixes: Traefik & Security Remediation Plan

\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 1. Document Title: NXCore Critical Fixes: Traefik & Security Remediation Plan
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 2. Motivation/Why:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
The stability and security of NXCore are paramount to the entire AeroVista ecosystem. Current issues, including Traefik middleware misconfigurations and the presence of default credentials, severely impact service availability, introduce significant secur
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ity vulnerabilities, and undermine trust in the infrastructure. Addressing these critical \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 fixes is essential to:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Restore Service Availability:** Ensure all core NXCore services (Authelia, OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Prometheus, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser) are fully operational and accessible.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Eliminate Security Risks:** Remove easily exploitable default credentials and harden the system against unauthorized access.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Enhance System Reliability:** Prevent future routing conflicts and ensure consistent service delivery.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Build Trust:** Provide a stable and secure foundatio\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 n for all dependent AeroVista projects.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Enable Further Development:** A stable NXCore is a prerequisite for successful cross-project integration and the implementation of advanced monitoring.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 3. Directions/How:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 This remediation plan outlines a phased approach to systematically address Traefik routing issues and implement robust security measures for NXCore. The process involves:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Phase 1: Traefik Configuration Refinement:** Consolidate Traefik routing logic to a "one truth per app" model us\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
ing Docker labels, reserving the File provider for global configurations only.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Phase 2: Credential Hardening:** Generate and securely apply new, strong credentials for all services, eliminating default and placeholder secrets.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Phase 3: Verification & Validation:** Thoroughly test all services post-remediation to confirm full functionality, correct routing, and enhanced security.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 4. How-Tos (Detailed Steps):
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ### Phase 1: Traefik Configuration Refinement
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Objective:** Resolve duplicate \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 service definitions and ensure correct sub-path routing.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Reference Documents:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\CURRENT_STATUS.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\DIRECTION.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\PLAN.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\compose-examples\\` \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 (for Docker label patterns)
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\traefik\\traefik-static.yml`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\traefik\\dynamic\\middlewares.yml`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Steps:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  **Snapshot Current State:** Before making any changes, save the output of `docker compose ls` and `docker ps -a`. Backup `/srv/traefik` and any custom dynamic configuration files.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   2.  **Consolidate Traefik File Provider:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Review `traefik-static.yml` to ensure `providers.file.directory` points correctly to `/srv/traefik/dynamic`.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Edit `dynamic/middlewares.yml` to contain *only* global middlewares (e.g., `sec-headers`, `redirect-https`).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   **Crucially, remove any application-specific routers or services from `dynamic/` files.** These should be managed by Docker labels.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     3.  **Verify Docker Label Patterns:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   For each service (Authelia,\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser), ensure its Docker Compose file (e.g., `compose-authelia.yml`) has the correct Traefik labels.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Verify that `traefik.enable=true` is set.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Confirm `traefik.http.routers.<name>.rule=PathPrefix(\\"/app_path\\")` is correctly defined for each service's sub-path.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Ensure `traefik.http.services.<name>.loadbalancer.server.port=<container_port>` points to the correct internal container port.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Verify `traefik.http.\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 routers.<name>.middlewares=sec-headers@file` is applied where security headers are desired.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   **Ensure each application is configured to be "sub-path aware"** (e.g., `N8N_PATH=/n8n/` for n8n, `WEBUI_BASE_URL=/ai/` for OpenWebUI). Use `StripPrefix` only if an app truly lacks base-path support.

\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     4.  **Restart Traefik and Services:** After modifying Docker Compose files and dynamic configurations, restart Traefik and the affected services to apply changes.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```bash
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         # Example: Restar\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 t Traefik
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         docker compose -f compose-traefik.yml down && docker compose -f compose-traefik.yml up -d
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         # Example: Restart a service
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         docker compose -f compose-authelia.yml down && docker compose -f compose-authelia.yml up -d
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
    5.  **Initial Verification:** Check the Traefik dashboard (`https://nxcore.tail79107c.ts.net/dashboard/`) to confirm that app services are now primarily listed under `@docker` and that route ambiguity is resolved.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ### Phase 2: Credential Hardening
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Objective:** Replace all default and placeholder credentials with strong, randomly generated passwords.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Reference Documents:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\Encrypted_Secrets_Vo\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 lume_Plan (1).md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\agent_rules.ssh_dev.md` (for secrets handling and `sops` usage)
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\PLAN.md` (Credential Reset task)
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Steps:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  **Establish Encrypted Secrets Volume:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Follow the steps in `Encrypted_Secrets_Volume_Plan (1).md` to create a 10-20 GB encrypted LVM logical volume at `/srv/sec\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ure` with strict mount options.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Decide on the unlock mode (passphrase at boot or TPM2 auto-unlock).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Ensure the volume is mounted and accessible with `drwx------` permissions.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
    2.  **Generate Strong Passwords:** For each service requiring credentials (e.g., Grafana, n8n, Authelia, PostgreSQL, Redis), generate new, strong, random passwords (e.g., using `pwgen -s 32 1` or `openssl rand -base64 32`).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     3.  **Encrypt `.env` Files with `sops`:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Store the generated passwor\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ds in service-specific `.env` files (e.g., `authelia.env`, `grafana.env`).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Use `sops` (with an Age key stored under `/srv/secure/secrets/keys/age.txt` as per `agent_rules.ssh_dev.md`) to encrypt these `.env` files.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Ensure encrypted `.env` files are stored securely, ideally within the `/srv/secure` volume.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     4.  **Update Docker Compose Configurations:** Modify the Docker Compose files for each service to reference the encrypted `.env` files or inject secrets securely. Ensure that se
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 crets are mounted with appropriate permissions (`0400`) and user context.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     5.  **Apply CIS Baseline for Ubuntu:** Implement security hardening measures for the underlying Ubuntu OS (e.g., `sshd`, `ufw`, `fail2ban`) as outlined in `NXCore_planing.html`.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ### Phase 3: Verification & Validation
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Objective:** Confirm that all services are fully functional, correctly routed, and securely configured.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Reference Documents:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastruct\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\scripts\\smoke-test.sh`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCore-Playwright-Testing-Report.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\Reports_and_Logs\\nxcore_interactive_plan_dev_client_walkthrough.html`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Steps:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  **Run Smoke Tests:** Execute `smoke-test.sh` to verify that all service endpoints return expected HTTP status codes and headers.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```bash
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         bash /path/to/NXCore.starter/scripts/smoke-test.sh
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     2.  **Manual Service Access:** Attempt to access each NXCore service (Authelia, OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser) via their respective URL\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
s in a web browser.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Verify successful loading of content, CSS, and JavaScript.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Confirm login functionality for services like Authelia and Grafana using the newly set credentials.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     3.  **Review Traefik Dashboard:** Re-check the Traefik dashboard to ensure all services are correctly identified and healthy.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     4.  **Playwright Testing (if available):** Run any existing Playwright end-to-end tests to simulate user behavior and validate service functionality and routing.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     5.  **Sec\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 urity Audit:** Conduct a basic security audit to confirm that default credentials are no longer active and that access controls are enforced.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     6.  **Update Status Dashboard:** Reflect the updated status of services in `nxcore_interactive_plan_dev_client_walkthrough.html` (if manual update is required, otherwise it should update dynamically).
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 5. Expected Outcome:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   NXCore service availability restored to 90%+ (target 100% for core services).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   All critical security vulnerabilities related to defa\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ult credentials eliminated.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   Consistent and correct routing for all services via Traefik.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   A stable, secure, and reliable foundational infrastructure for the AeroVista ecosystem.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 6. Responsible Parties (Suggested):
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Primary:** Infrastructure Team
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Support:** Security Team, DevOps
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 7. Dependencies:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   None (this is a high-priority foundational step that enables other recommendations).}{\rtlch\fcs1 \af31507 \ltrch\fcs0 \insrsid1835774

\fs24\lang1033\langfe1033\kerning2\loch\af31506\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\cgrid\langnp1033\langfenp1033 {\rtlch\fcs1 \af31507 \ltrch\fcs0 \insrsid6037862 \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 # NXCore Critical Fixes: Traefik & Security Remediation Plan

\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 1. Document Title: NXCore Critical Fixes: Traefik & Security Remediation Plan
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 2. Motivation/Why:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
The stability and security of NXCore are paramount to the entire AeroVista ecosystem. Current issues, including Traefik middleware misconfigurations and the presence of default credentials, severely impact service availability, introduce significant secur
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ity vulnerabilities, and undermine trust in the infrastructure. Addressing these critical \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 fixes is essential to:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Restore Service Availability:** Ensure all core NXCore services (Authelia, OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Prometheus, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser) are fully operational and accessible.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Eliminate Security Risks:** Remove easily exploitable default credentials and harden the system against unauthorized access.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Enhance System Reliability:** Prevent future routing conflicts and ensure consistent service delivery.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Build Trust:** Provide a stable and secure foundatio\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 n for all dependent AeroVista projects.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Enable Further Development:** A stable NXCore is a prerequisite for successful cross-project integration and the implementation of advanced monitoring.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 3. Directions/How:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 This remediation plan outlines a phased approach to systematically address Traefik routing issues and implement robust security measures for NXCore. The process involves:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Phase 1: Traefik Configuration Refinement:** Consolidate Traefik routing logic to a "one truth per app" model us\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
ing Docker labels, reserving the File provider for global configurations only.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Phase 2: Credential Hardening:** Generate and securely apply new, strong credentials for all services, eliminating default and placeholder secrets.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Phase 3: Verification & Validation:** Thoroughly test all services post-remediation to confirm full functionality, correct routing, and enhanced security.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ## 4. How-Tos (Detailed Steps):
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ### Phase 1: Traefik Configuration Refinement
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Objective:** Resolve duplicate \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 service definitions and ensure correct sub-path routing.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Reference Documents:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\CURRENT_STATUS.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\DIRECTION.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\PLAN.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\compose-examples\\` \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 (for Docker label patterns)
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\traefik\\traefik-static.yml`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\traefik\\dynamic\\middlewares.yml`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Steps:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  **Snapshot Current State:** Before making any changes, save the output of `docker compose ls` and `docker ps -a`. Backup `/srv/traefik` and any custom dynamic configuration files.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   2.  **Consolidate Traefik File Provider:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Review `traefik-static.yml` to ensure `providers.file.directory` points correctly to `/srv/traefik/dynamic`.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Edit `dynamic/middlewares.yml` to contain *only* global middlewares (e.g., `sec-headers`, `redirect-https`).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   **Crucially, remove any application-specific routers or services from `dynamic/` files.** These should be managed by Docker labels.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     3.  **Verify Docker Label Patterns:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   For each service (Authelia,\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser), ensure its Docker Compose file (e.g., `compose-authelia.yml`) has the correct Traefik labels.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Verify that `traefik.enable=true` is set.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Confirm `traefik.http.routers.<name>.rule=PathPrefix(\\"/app_path\\")` is correctly defined for each service's sub-path.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Ensure `traefik.http.services.<name>.loadbalancer.server.port=<container_port>` points to the correct internal container port.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Verify `traefik.http.\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 routers.<name>.middlewares=sec-headers@file` is applied where security headers are desired.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   **Ensure each application is configured to be "sub-path aware"** (e.g., `N8N_PATH=/n8n/` for n8n, `WEBUI_BASE_URL=/ai/` for OpenWebUI). Use `StripPrefix` only if an app truly lacks base-path support.

\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     4.  **Restart Traefik and Services:** After modifying Docker Compose files and dynamic configurations, restart Traefik and the affected services to apply changes.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```bash
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         # Example: Restar\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 t Traefik
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         docker compose -f compose-traefik.yml down && docker compose -f compose-traefik.yml up -d
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         # Example: Restart a service
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         docker compose -f compose-authelia.yml down && docker compose -f compose-authelia.yml up -d
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
    5.  **Initial Verification:** Check the Traefik dashboard (`https://nxcore.tail79107c.ts.net/dashboard/`) to confirm that app services are now primarily listed under `@docker` and that route ambiguity is resolved.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ### Phase 2: Credential Hardening
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Objective:** Replace all default and placeholder credentials with strong, randomly generated passwords.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Reference Documents:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\Encrypted_Secrets_Vo\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 lume_Plan (1).md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\agent_rules.ssh_dev.md` (for secrets handling and `sops` usage)
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\docs\\PLAN.md` (Credential Reset task)
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Steps:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  **Establish Encrypted Secrets Volume:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Follow the steps in `Encrypted_Secrets_Volume_Plan (1).md` to create a 10-20 GB encrypted LVM logical volume at `/srv/sec\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ure` with strict mount options.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Decide on the unlock mode (passphrase at boot or TPM2 auto-unlock).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Ensure the volume is mounted and accessible with `drwx------` permissions.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
    2.  **Generate Strong Passwords:** For each service requiring credentials (e.g., Grafana, n8n, Authelia, PostgreSQL, Redis), generate new, strong, random passwords (e.g., using `pwgen -s 32 1` or `openssl rand -base64 32`).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     3.  **Encrypt `.env` Files with `sops`:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Store the generated passwor\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ds in service-specific `.env` files (e.g., `authelia.env`, `grafana.env`).
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Use `sops` (with an Age key stored under `/srv/secure/secrets/keys/age.txt` as per `agent_rules.ssh_dev.md`) to encrypt these `.env` files.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Ensure encrypted `.env` files are stored securely, ideally within the `/srv/secure` volume.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     4.  **Update Docker Compose Configurations:** Modify the Docker Compose files for each service to reference the encrypted `.env` files or inject secrets securely. Ensure that se
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 crets are mounted with appropriate permissions (`0400`) and user context.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     5.  **Apply CIS Baseline for Ubuntu:** Implement security hardening measures for the underlying Ubuntu OS (e.g., `sshd`, `ufw`, `fail2ban`) as outlined in `NXCore_planing.html`.
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ### Phase 3: Verification & Validation
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Objective:** Confirm that all services are fully functional, correctly routed, and securely configured.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Reference Documents:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastruct\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ure\\NXCore\\NXCOre\\NXCore.starter\\scripts\\smoke-test.sh`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\AeroVista_LLC\\Technology_and_Infrastructure\\NXCore\\NXCore-Playwright-Testing-Report.md`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     *   `X:\\CURRENT NOTES AND TASKS\\Reports_and_Logs\\nxcore_interactive_plan_dev_client_walkthrough.html`
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 *   **Steps:**
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  **Run Smoke Tests:** Execute `smoke-test.sh` to verify that all service endpoints return expected HTTP status codes and headers.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```bash
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         bash /path/to/NXCore.starter/scripts/smoke-test.sh
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         ```
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     2.  **Manual Service Access:** Attempt to access each NXCore service (Authelia, OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser) via their respective URL\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
s in a web browser.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Verify successful loading of content, CSS, and JavaScript.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506         *   Confirm login functionality for services like Authelia and Grafana using the newly set credentials.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     3.  **Review Traefik Dashboard:** Re-check the Traefik dashboard to ensure all services are correctly identified and healthy.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     4.  **Playwright Testing (if available):** Run any existing Playwright end-to-end tests to simulate user behavior and validate service functionality and routing.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     5.  **Sec\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 urity Audit:** Conduct a basic security audit to confirm that default credentials are no longer active and that access controls are enforced.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     6.  **Update Status Dashboard:** Reflect the updated status of services in `nxcore_interactive_plan_dev_client_walkthrough.html` (if manual update is required, otherwise it should update dynamically).
\par

nxcore_interactive_plan_dev_client_walkthrough.html

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>NXCore — Interactive Completion Plan</title>
  <style>
    :root{--bg:#0f172a;--bg2:#111827;--card:#111827;--muted:#94a3b8;--fg:#e5e7eb;--pri:#06b6d4;--ok:#22c55e;--warn:#f59e0b;--bad:#ef4444;--accent:#a78bfa}
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    body{margin:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1224,#0f172a);color:var(--fg);font:16px/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Inter,Helvetica,Arial}
    a{color:var(--pri)}
    .wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px}
    header{position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:10;border-bottom:1px solid #1f2937}
    .bar{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0}
    .title{font-weight:800;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #1f2937;background:#0b1220;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted)}
    .grid{display:grid;gap:16px}
    @media(min-width:900px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
    .card{background:radial-gradient(1200px 400px at -10% -30%,rgba(167,139,250,.08),transparent),radial-gradient(800px 300px at 120% 10%,rgba(6,182,212,.08),transparent),#0b1220;border:1px solid #1f2937;border-radius:16px;padding:16px}
    .card h3{margin:0 0 10px 0;font-size:18px}
    .muted{color:var(--muted)}
    .chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #263244;background:#0e1527;color:#b8c3d9;font-size:12px}
    .ok{color:#10b981}.warn{color:#f59e0b}.bad{color:#ef4444}.pri{color:var(--pri)}
    .btn{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #1f2937;background:#0e162a;color:#e5e7eb;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px}
    .btn:hover{border-color:#334155}
    .btn.ghost{background:transparent}
    .toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
    .kpi{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .kpi .box{background:#0c152a;border:1px solid #1f2937;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px}
    .kpi .val{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
    details{border:1px solid #1f2937;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;background:#0b1325}
    details>summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none}
    code,pre{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Monaco,Consolas,monospace}
    pre{background:#0a1322;border:1px solid #1f2937;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;overflow:auto}
    .row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
    .list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}
    .task{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px;border:1px solid #203045;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1222,#0f1a2e)}
    .task small{color:var(--muted)}
    .pill{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #263244;background:#0e1527;color:#b8c3d9;font-size:12px}
    .hidden{display:none !important}
    .footer{margin:24px 0;color:#7f8ea8}
    .sep{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#243244,transparent);margin:16px 0}
    .copy{cursor:pointer;border:1px dashed #2a3a54;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;color:#cde4ff}
    .mode-toggle{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
    .note{font-size:13px;color:#9fb0c8}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header>
    <div class="wrap bar">
      <div class="title">NXCore — Interactive Completion Plan</div>
      <div class="toolbar">
        <div class="mode-toggle">
          <span class="muted">View:</span>
          <button class="btn" id="modeDev">Developer</button>
          <button class="btn ghost" id="modeClient">Client</button>
        </div>
        <button class="btn" id="btnExport">Export Progress</button>
        <label class="btn" for="importFile">Import</label>
        <input id="importFile" type="file" accept="application/json" class="hidden" />
        <button class="btn" id="btnPrint">Save as PDF</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="wrap">
    <div class="kpi">
      <div class="box"><div class="val" id="kpiDone">3</div><div class="muted">Completed Tracks</div></div>
      <div class="box"><div class="val" id="kpiActive">3</div><div class="muted">In Progress</div></div>
      <div class="box"><div class="val" id="kpiPending">5</div><div class="muted">Planned</div></div>
      <div class="box"><div class="val" id="kpiETA">4.0d</div><div class="muted">ETA to Go‑Live (best effort)</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="sep"></div>

    <section class="grid">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Overview</h3>
        <p class="muted">Objective: bring NXCore to production-ready state by closing identity, storage, observability, and backup gaps. Toggle <b>Developer</b>/<b>Client</b> view to show or hide deep technical details.</p>
        <div class="list">
          <div class="chip">Updated: <span id="stamp"></span></div>
          <div class="chip">Owner: Infra</div>
          <div class="chip">Version: v1.0 Walkthrough</div>
          <div class="chip"><a href="../../AeroVista_LLC/MASTER_PROJECT_LIST.md">Master Project List</a></div>
          <div class="chip"><a href="../../AeroVista_LLC/PROJECT_TRACKER.md">Project Tracker</a></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Benefits</h3>
        <ul class="muted">
          <li>Centralized SSO with audit trail (compliance, safe access)</li>
          <li>Resilient storage + tested backups (RPO/RTO clarity)</li>
          <li>Observable services (dashboards + alerts + runbooks)</li>
          <li>Client transparency with a guided, non-technical view</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Key Insights</h3>
        <ul class="muted">
          <li>Strong focus on AI, music-related projects, system/file management.</li>
          <li>Emphasis on security, performance optimization, and user experience across all projects.</li>
          <li>Recurring themes of integration, automation, and robust error handling.</li>
          <li>Significant interdependencies between NXCore, AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse, and Memory Mapper.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Cross-Project Dependencies</h3>
        <ul class="muted">
          <li><b>NXCore:</b> Central infrastructure for AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse, RydeSync, Memory Mapper, Ops Hub, ByteCoreLite.</li>
          <li><b>AeroCoreOS:</b> UI/UX layer, integrates with EchoVerse, RydeSync, and Memory Mapper (planned).</li>
          <li><b>ByteCoreLite:</b> Field operations, supports AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse, Memory Mapper.</li>
          <li><b>Memory Mapper:</b> Provides intelligence and documentation for AeroCoreOS, ByteCoreLite, Seasons of Change.</li>
          <li><b>EchoVerse:</b> Music platform, connected to Bonsaid, AeroCoreOS, RydeSync, Ops Hub.</li>
          <li><b>RydeSync:</b> Real-time sync, integrates with NXCore, AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse.</li>
          <li><b>Ops Hub:</b> Backend service for NXCore, includes EchoVerse tools.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="sep"></div>

    <section class="grid">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Status Roll‑Up</h3>
        <div class="list" id="statusList"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Acceptance Criteria</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Authelia UI + styles load; login succeeds; groups/claims applied</li>
          <li>Traefik routers visible; HTTP cert fetch works</li>
          <li>Daily PostgreSQL backups run and restore test passes</li>
          <li>Grafana dashboards + alerts configured; runbooks linked</li>
          <li>Playwright strict TLS green; mock data removed</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="sep"></div>

    <section class="card">
      <h3>Tasks</h3>
      <p class="note">Check items off as you complete them. Use the copy buttons to grab commands.</p>

      <h4>In Progress</h4>
      <div class="list" id="tasksInProgress"></div>

      <h4>Planned</h4>
      <div class="list" id="tasksPlanned"></div>

      <h4>Completed</h4>
      <div class="list" id="tasksCompleted"></div>

    </section>

    <div class="sep"></div>

    <section class="grid">
      <div class="card dev">
        <h3>Risk & Mitigations (Dev)</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><b>I/O stalls on image delete</b> → Detach loop, check <code>dmesg</code>, fallback to single‑user delete.</li>
          <li><b>Auth UI assets mismatch</b> → Validate container workdir + asset path; add e2e check for <code>/auth/manifest.json</code>.</li>
          <li><b>Backups untested</b> → Weekly restore rehearsal; gate changes on last-pass success.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Go‑Live Checklist</h3>
        <ul id="golive">
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="routers"/> Traefik routers + HTTP cert path</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="health"/> Authelia health + Redis healthcheck & depends_on</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="assets"/> Authelia UI assets served</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="backups"/> Postgres daily backups + restore test</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="grafana"/> Grafana dashboards + alerts + contacts</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="mock"/> Mock data removed</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="tls"/> Playwright strict TLS green</label></li>
          <li><label><input type="checkbox" data-check="runbooks"/> Runbooks linked in Grafana</label></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

    <p class="footer">Tip: Use <b>Export Progress</b> to save state as JSON and share with teammates or clients. <b>Save as PDF</b> creates a clean handout.</p>
  </main>

  <template id="taskTmpl">
    <div class="task">
      <input type="checkbox" class="t-check"/>
      <div>
        <div class="row"><strong class="t-title"></strong><span class="pill t-eta"></span></div>
        <div class="muted t-desc"></div>
        <details class="dev">
          <summary>Commands</summary>
          <pre class="t-code"></pre>
          <div class="copy" title="Copy to clipboard">Copy</div>
        </details>
      </div>
      <div class="pill t-owner"></div>
    </div>
  </template>

  <script>
    const plan = {
      updatedAt: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      status: [
        {title:"Seeding Protocol v2", state:"done"},
        {title:"NXCore Dashboard Initial Setup", state:"done"},
        {title:"Traefik Configuration Refinement", state:"done"},
        {title:"NXCore Service Connectivity", state:"active"},
        {title:"NXCore Dashboard GUI", state:"active"},
        {title:"AeroCoreOS UI Standards Rollout", state:"active"},
        {title:"EchoVerse HTTPS Activation", state:"active"},
        {title:"RydeSync Redis Migration", state:"active"},
        {title:"Memory Mapper Performance Optimization", state:"active"},
        {title:"Playwright CA trust (strict TLS)", state:"pending"},
        {title:"Daily Postgres backups + retention + restore test", state:"pending"},
        {title:"Grafana dashboards + alerts + contact points", state:"pending"},
        {title:"Mock data purge before prod", state:"pending"},
        {title:"ByteCoreLite Phase 2 Hardening", state:"pending"}
      ],
      tasks: [
        {
          title:"Fix NXCore Network Connectivity",
          owner:"Infra",
          eta:"0.5d",
          desc:"Troubleshoot and fix network connectivity issues preventing service access.",
          code:`docker network inspect gateway\ndocker exec traefik ping <service-name>\n# Check compose files for network configuration`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Fix NXCore Dashboard GUI",
          owner:"Infra",
          eta:"0.5d",
          desc:"Manually launch Chromium with --disable-gpu flags to resolve black screen issue.",
          code:`DISPLAY=:1 chromium-browser --kiosk --disable-gpu http://localhost:8080`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Deploy and Test Services",
          owner:"Infra",
          eta:"1.0d",
          desc:"Deploy all 13 NXCore applications individually and run smoke tests.",
          code:`# For each service...\ndocker compose -f compose-<service-name>.yml up -d\n# Then run smoke tests...\nbash /path/to/NXCore.starter/scripts/smoke-test.sh`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Harden Credentials",
          owner:"Security/Infra",
          eta:"1.0d",
          desc:"Replace all default and placeholder credentials with strong, randomly generated passwords.",
          code:`# Generate passwords\npwgen -s 32 1\n# Store in encrypted volume and update compose files`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Implement Boot Orchestration",
          owner:"Infra",
          eta:"0.5d",
          desc:"Install nxcore-start.sh and systemd service for boot orchestration.",
          code:`# Install script and service file\ncp nxcore-start.sh /usr/local/bin/\ncp systemd/nxcore-start.service /etc/systemd/system/\n# Enable and start service\nsystemctl enable nxcore-start.service\nsystemctl start nxcore-start.service`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Setup Uptime Monitoring",
          owner:"Observability",
          eta:"0.5d",
          desc:"Add Uptime Kuma checks for all service endpoints.",
          code:`# Add new monitors in Uptime Kuma UI for all services`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Finalize Seeding Protocol UI",
          owner:"Nexus TechWorks",
          eta:"1.0d",
          desc:"Complete the HTML UI wrapper for the Seeding Protocol, including the CLI subprocess hook and real-time preview.",
          code:`# Continue development of the HTML UI wrapper`,
          done:false
        },
        {
          title:"Seeding Protocol v2",
          owner:"Nexus TechWorks",
          eta:"0d",
          desc:"The CLI tool (v1) is complete, with support for 9 seed types, various command-line arguments, and the ability to generate templates and ZIP bundles.",
          code:``,
          done:true
        },
        {
          title:"NXCore Dashboard Initial Setup",
          owner:"Infra",
          eta:"0d",
          desc:"The Flask application has been restored and is serving system metrics, and the underlying GUI components, including the LightDM display manager and Openbox, are active.",
          code:``,
          done:true
        }
      ],
      checks: {}
    };

    // State + hydration
    const $$ = (q,root=document)=>root.querySelector(q);
    const list = $$("#statusList");
    const taskList = $$("#taskList");
    const stamp = $$("#stamp");

    function paintStatus(){
      list.innerHTML = '';
      let done=0,active=0,pending=0;
      plan.status.forEach(s=>{
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        const color = s.state==='done'?'ok':s.state==='active'?'warn':'muted';
        row.className='row';
        row.innerHTML = `<div>${s.title}</div><div class="pill ${color}">${s.state.toUpperCase()}</div>`;
        list.appendChild(row);
        if(s.state==='done') done++; else if(s.state==='active') active++; else pending++;
      });
      $$("#kpiDone").textContent = done;
      $$("#kpiActive").textContent = active;
      $$("#kpiPending").textContent = pending;
      // naive ETA: sum task etas remaining (0.5d=0.5, etc.)
      const days = plan.tasks.filter(t=>!t.done).reduce((a,t)=>a+parseFloat(t.eta),0);
      $$("#kpiETA").textContent = days.toFixed(1)+"d";
    }

    function makeTask(t){
      const tpl = document.getElementById('taskTmpl');
      const node = tpl.content.cloneNode(true);
      const root = node.querySelector('.task');
      root.querySelector('.t-title').textContent = t.title;
      root.querySelector('.t-desc').textContent = t.desc;
      root.querySelector('.t-code').textContent = t.code;
      root.querySelector('.t-eta').textContent = 'ETA ' + t.eta;
      root.querySelector('.t-owner').textContent = t.owner;
      const chk = root.querySelector('.t-check');
      chk.checked = !!t.done;
      chk.addEventListener('change',()=>{t.done = chk.checked; persist(); paintStatus();});
      root.querySelector('.copy').addEventListener('click',()=>{
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(t.code); 
        const btn = root.querySelector('.copy');
        btn.textContent='Copied!'; setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent='Copy',1200);
      });
      return node;
    }

    function paintTasks(){
      $$("#tasksInProgress").innerHTML='';
      $$("#tasksPlanned").innerHTML='';
      $$("#tasksCompleted").innerHTML='';

      plan.tasks.forEach(t=> {
        if(t.done) {
          $$("#tasksCompleted").appendChild(makeTask(t));
        } else if (t.eta && parseFloat(t.eta) > 0) { // Assuming ETA > 0 means in progress or planned
          $$("#tasksInProgress").appendChild(makeTask(t));
        } else {
          $$("#tasksPlanned").appendChild(makeTask(t));
        }
      });
    }

    function paintChecks(){
      document.querySelectorAll('#golive input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb=>{
        cb.checked = !!plan.checks[cb.dataset.check];
        cb.addEventListener('change',()=>{plan.checks[cb.dataset.check]=cb.checked; persist();});
      });
    }

    function persist(){ localStorage.setItem('nxcore-plan', JSON.stringify(plan)); }

    function load(){
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('nxcore-plan');
      if(raw){ try{ const s = JSON.parse(raw); Object.assign(plan, s); }catch{}}
    }

    function setMode(mode){
      const dev = mode==='dev';
      document.querySelectorAll('.dev').forEach(el=> el.classList.toggle('hidden', !dev));
      $$('#modeDev').classList.toggle('ghost', !dev);
      $$('#modeClient').classList.toggle('ghost', dev);
    }

    // Export/Import/Print
    $$('#btnExport').addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(plan,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download='nxcore-plan-progress.json'; a.click();
    });
    $$('#importFile').addEventListener('change',(e)=>{
      const f = e.target.files[0]; if(!f) return;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = ()=>{ try{ const s = JSON.parse(r.result); Object.assign(plan, s); persist(); hydrate(); }catch{ alert('Invalid JSON'); } };
      r.readAsText(f);
    });
    $$('#btnPrint').addEventListener('click',()=>window.print());

    // Mode toggle
    $$('#modeDev').addEventListener('click',()=>setMode('dev'));
    $$('#modeClient').addEventListener('click',()=>setMode('client'));

    function hydrate(){
      stamp.textContent = plan.updatedAt;
      paintStatus();
      paintTasks();
      paintChecks();
    }

    load();
    hydrate();
    setMode('dev');
  </script>
</body>
</html>

\fs24\lang1033\langfe1033\kerning2\loch\af31506\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\cgrid\langnp1033\langfenp1033 {\rtlch\fcs1 \af0\afs56 \ltrch\fcs0 \cs15\f43\fs56\insrsid5378152\charrsid5378152 Overall Status Report: AeroVista LLC Ecosystem}{\rtlch\fcs1 \af31507 
\ltrch\fcs0 \insrsid5378152 \line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   Date: November 3, 2025\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   1. Executive Summary\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
  The AeroVista LLC ecosystem is a dynamic and actively developing environment, characterized by a diverse\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   portfolio of projects spanning core infrastructure, AI-powered intelligence, creative publishing, and
\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   specialized field operations. Significant progress has been made in establishing robust foundational\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
  systems, automating key processes, and enhancing cross-project integration. While many projects are\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   operational or in advanced development, critical areas such as security hardening, performance\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   optimization, and comprehensive documentation remain ongoing priorities. The ecosystem demonstrates a\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
  strong commitment to AI integration, secure operations, and delivering a seamless user experience across\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506   its various platforms.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
  2. Key Projects and Current Status\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  NXCore (Central Infrastructure):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Status: Partially functional (33% services working as per latest report, but a comprehensive audit\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          indicates 78% service availability with fixes ready for deployment). Critical issues with Traefik
\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          middleware, security vulnerabilities (default credentials), and inaccurate status monitoring have\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          been identified and solutions are prepared.\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Robust routing, certificate management, encrypted secrets, monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus),\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
         and automated deployment.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Central to AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse, RydeSync, Memory Mapper, Ops Hub, ByteCoreLite.\line \line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  AeroCoreOS (Desktop Environment):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Status: Core boot process, window management, data persistence, theme system, and IPC communication\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          are functional. UI standards are defined and implementation is in progress.\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Modular, privacy-first Electron-based desktop environment for productivity and collaboration.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Integrates with EchoVerse, RydeSync, Memory Mapper (planned), and ByteCore field\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          operations.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  ByteCoreLite (Field Operations System):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Status: Production Ready - Field Deployed (Phase 1 operational). Phase 2 (refinement & hardening)\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          and Phase 3 (dreambuild deployment) are planned.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Mobile reconnaissance and command system (Raspberry Pi 4) for network monitoring, logging,\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          and remote control, integrated into a Surron electric bike.
\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Supports AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse, Memory Mapper.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Memory Mapper (AI Content Intelligence):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Status: Fully operational. Processed over 175K records, successfully generating detailed\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          documentation for other projects. Ongoing tasks include performance optimization and dashboard\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          improvements.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
       \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: AI-powered system for transforming unstructured data into searchable insights, featuring\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          semantic search and an interactive Streamlit dashboard.
\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Provides intelligence and documentation for AeroCoreOS, ByteCoreLite, Seasons of\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          Change.\line 
\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  EchoVerse Music Platform (Mini-Shop Player):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Status: Fully functional web-based audio player with advanced visualizer capabilities. All major\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          development work completed.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Engaging multimedia experience with professional-grade visual effects and enhanced user\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          experience.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Connected to Bonsaid, AeroCoreOS, RydeSync, Ops Hub.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Bonsaid (Music Player & Store):\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Status: Fully operational with a complete music player and integrated e-commerce store.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Advanced audio visualization, EQ controls, multi-track playlist management, and Square\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          payment integration.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
       \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Music-related initiative within the Creative & Publishing division.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 RydeSync (Communication Platform):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Status: In development. Core features like P2P voice rooms and music synchronization are being\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          implemented.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Real-time music and communication sync platform for group rides.\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Integrates with NXCore, AeroCoreOS, EchoVerse.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Ops Hub (Script Runner Dashboard):\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Status: Operational. Provides a web-based interface for running Python scripts.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
       \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Automating local Python utilities into "push-button tools," managing job logs, and tracking\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          history.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
       \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Dependencies: Backend service for NXCore, includes EchoVerse tools.\line \line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Seasons of Change (Publishing Series):\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Status: In development (60% complete). "Winter's Wisdom" completed, "Spring's Awakening" nearing\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506          completion.\line 
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506        \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Focus: Creative writing series with companion materials and marketing campaigns.\line \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506

\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
The stability and security of NXCore are paramount to the entire AeroVista ecosystem. Current issues, including Traefik middleware misconfigurations and the presence of default credentials, severely impact service availability, introduce significant secur
\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 ity vulnerabilities, and undermine trust in the infrastructure. Addressing these critical fixes is essential to:
\par 
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 Restore Service Availability:\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 Ensure all core NXCore services (Authelia, OpenWebUI, n8n, Grafana, Prometheus, Uptime Kuma, Dozzle, FileBrowser) are fully operational and accessible.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 Eliminate Security Risks:\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Remove easily exploitable default credentials and harden the system against unauthorized access.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 Enhance System Reliability:\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Prevent future routing conflicts and ensure consistent service delivery.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 Build Trust:\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Provide a stable and secure foundation for all dependent AeroVista projects.
\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506    \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 Enable Further Development:\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 
 A stable NXCore is a prerequisite for successful cross-project integration and the implementation of advanced monitoring.
\par

\par \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506     1.  \hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506 Run Smoke Tests:\hich\af31506\dbch\af31505\loch\f31506  Execute `smoke-test.sh` to verify that all service endpoints return expected HTTP status codes and headers.
